About Revaly

Revaly is the essential infrastructure for payments, protecting revenue, relationships, and the integrity of digital commerce. We make sure what you earn, you keep.

Our platform helps performance-driven businesses unlock hidden growth by turning failed or at-risk payments into approved revenue. We connect merchants and issuers in real time, using intelligence drawn from across the payment ecosystem to make approvals work smarter.

About the Role

As Director of Marketing, you’ll own Revaly’s marketing strategy and turn our product, technology, and payments expertise into a category-defining story that drives market adoption and revenue growth. Reporting to the SVP of Growth, you’ll lead a team of marketing specialists and work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success to bring our story to market with clarity and speed. Your focus: building Revaly’s position in Payment Performance Management, translating complex product capabilities into compelling market narratives, and creating a scalable go-to-market engine that generates demand, enables Sales, and accelerates growth.

Salary Range: $120,000–$150,000 CAD annually. The final offer will be determined based on the successful candidate’s experience, skills, location, and overall fit for the role.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own Revaly’s marketing and go-to-market strategy, connecting company and product priorities to measurable pipeline, adoption, and revenue outcomes.
• Lead product marketing across current, and future Revaly offerings, translating complex payment technology and product capabilities into clear positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market plans.
• Build and evolve the Payment Performance Management category story, creating the narratives, market education, and thought leadership that establish Revaly as a credible category leader.
• Own product launches and go-to-market programs from strategy through execution, partnering closely with Product and commercial teams to bring new capabilities to market quickly and effectively.
• Develop differentiated competitive positioning and market intelligence that helps Revaly sharpen its strategy, messaging, and commercial approach.
• Lead the overall demand generation strategy, providing direction and oversight to scale integrated programs across digital, content, email, SDR, field marketing, and owned channels that convert market awareness into qualified pipeline.
• Partner closely with Sales to develop enablement materials, talk tracks, battle cards, customer stories, and outbound assets that make Revaly’s value easier to understand and sell.
• Lead Revaly’s content and executive thought leadership strategy, turning product expertise, customer insights, payments data, and market trends into compelling market-facing narratives.
• Drive co-marketing programs with strategic partners, platforms, issuers, and channel relationships, ensuring consistent positioning and coordinated execution.
• Lead field marketing initiatives including conferences, webinars, roundtables, customer events, and executive engagement programs.
• Establish marketing KPIs, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms tied to engagement, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, and revenue impact.
• Build scalable marketing systems, processes, automation workflows, and AI-enabled ways of working that increase the team’s speed and effectiveness.
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of marketing specialists, creating clear priorities and a high bar for strategic thinking, creativity, accountability, and execution.
• Serve as Marketing’s strategic voice across Sales, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Executive Leadership, contributing to company planning and shaping Revaly’s broader go-to-market roadmap.

What You Bring

• 5–7+ years of product marketing experience, ideally within payments, fintech, payment infrastructure, or another complex B2B technology environment.
• Strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, with the ability to understand merchant and issuer needs, payment approval challenges, and the technology that connects them.
• A track record of translating complex technical products into clear positioning, differentiated messaging, compelling customer value propositions, and effective go-to-market programs.
• Experience owning product marketing across launches, market and customer research, competitive intelligence, positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and adoption.
• Experience building or shaping an emerging market category, including developing the narrative and education required to create market understanding and demand.
• Experience leading and developing a team of marketing specialists, with the ability to set strategy while staying close enough to execution to move work forward.
• Demonstrated experience building integrated B2B demand generation programs and connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
• Strong analytical capabilities and experience establishing marketing KPIs, funnel reporting, attribution, and performance measurement.
• Experience partnering closely with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and executive teams on go-to-market strategy and execution.
• Familiarity or curiosity with AI-powered productivity tools.
• A calm, confident communicator who thrives in fast-moving, high-accountability environments.

What Success Looks Like

• Within the first 6 months, Revaly has a sharper, differentiated category and product narrative that clearly communicates Payment Performance Management, and Revaly’s value across priority audiences.
• Within the first 6 months, repeatable product marketing processes are in place for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and cross-functional go-to-market planning.
• Within 6–9 months, integrated marketing programs are generating measurable qualified pipeline, with clear funnel reporting and visibility into marketing’s contribution to revenue.
• Within 6–9 months, Sales and partner-facing teams have a consistent set of messaging, enablement tools, customer stories, and competitive resources that improve confidence and effectiveness in market conversations.
• Within the first 12 months, Revaly has measurably increased awareness and understanding of the Payment Performance Management category among priority buyers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
• Within the first 12 months, Revaly has a scalable marketing operating system with clear KPIs, reporting, processes, ownership, and a high-performing team capable of supporting the company’s next stage of growth.

Why Revaly

We’re a growing global company committed to building a team filled with diverse cultures, viewpoints, and experiences. As they say, variety is the spice of life. No matter how large we become, we will always be connected through our shared sense of community and slightly quirky personalities.

Our vibrant culture is filled with talented, creative, deeply curious, high achievers. We believe in and invest in our people because we know they are the secret to our success. We are happy to extend the following benefits to our employees:

  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 100% remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • Comprehensive health benefits package effective from day one

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We believe hiring should feel like a conversation, not a test. Here’s what you can expect if you apply:

Step 1 — Conversation with People & Culture (30 minutes)
If your experience looks like a fit, you’ll meet with our Head of People & Culture for a video chat. It’s a two-way conversation, we’ll learn about your background, skills, and what energizes you, and you’ll have space to ask about Revaly, our mission, and what it’s like to work here. It’s also a chance to make sure the vibes are right on both sides.

Step 2 — Conversation with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes)
Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a deeper dive into your role-specific experience. We’ll talk through real scenarios, how you approach challenges, and what success looks like in this role. You’ll also get a clearer picture of the team’s goals and priorities.

Step 3 — Meet a Future Teammate (60 minutes)
In this stage, you’ll meet with someone from the team you’ll work closely with. This is your chance to get an on-the-ground perspective, how the team collaborates, what day-to-day looks like, and the kind of people you’ll be building alongside.

Step 4 — 90 Day Ramp Up Presentation (30 minutes)
In this final stage, we ask candidates to prepare and present a 90 day ramp up plan to the hiring manager. This is an opportunity for candidates to outline how they would approach their first 3 months in the role, what they’d aim to learn, prioritize, and accomplish. This is a chance to show your understanding of the role, the company, and the environment we’re operating in, while giving the hiring manager a glimpse into how you think, structure your approach to learning and communicate your ideas.

We hire for both skill and fit, looking for people who are not just aligned with our values, but who will add to our culture with their ideas, energy, and perspective.
If you’ve applied for a role in Technology or Product Development, you can also expect a skill-based assessment between step 3 and 4, to help us assess some key role-based requirements.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Conversion Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC, SLT, LVM, and S/4HANA migration tools with deep understanding of SAP data structures, business processes, and data governance, and will partner closely with functional teams, business owners, and infrastructure stakeholders during all phases of migration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.

Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies.   • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.

  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

Your designs won't end up in a drawer; you'll take them from the first client workshop all the way to production, working with international startups, scale-ups, and enterprise clients, side by side with a world-class UX team and developers who genuinely care about design. It's a permanent, full-time role: fixed monthly salary and full benefits from day one.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008: wearables, smart audio, and health-tech hardware for clients like Oura, BOSE, and McIntosh, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and we've been AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. If you've ever designed a pairing flow and felt weirdly proud when the LED actually blinked, you already get why we love what we do.

Who this role is NOT for

If you want a neat list of tickets every morning, and design for you means filling in screens someone else already thought through, we're probably not your people. Same if you work 8-16, log off, and would rather never hear about design systems, experiments, or knowledge-sharing again. We look for designers who ask "why" before "how", who show their work early, and who care about the device on the other end of the screen, not just the screen itself. And we're AI-native: if AI tools feel like a gimmick to you, we're not the right fit.

What you'll do

  • Conduct design workshops with clients and turn messy inputs into clear design directions

  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and prototypes for new and existing products and features, mostly native iOS and Android apps

  • Design interfaces where software meets hardware: pairing flows, device status, sensor data visualization

  • Support projects from initial design to final production, in close collaboration with developers, QA, and PMs

  • Help implement and develop our new branding

  • Push and experiment with new ideas, trends, and tools, and turn the good ones into team standards

  • Share knowledge within and outside of intent: chapter sessions, tech talks, the design community

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of commercial experience in UI design; product design is something you genuinely enjoy living and breathing

  • Advanced Figma skills: design systems built on components and auto-layouts, and files other designers can actually navigate

  • Hands-on experience designing interfaces for IoT and connected devices (not "I read about it once")

  • A broad portfolio of visually rich work you're proud to walk us through

  • Solid knowledge of Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Android platform guidelines, paired with a real passion for mobile technology

  • Some experience with motion and animation, not only static screens

  • The basics of Photoshop and Illustrator

  • Very good English (C1), because our clients are mostly US-based

  • Confidence presenting designs to clients and explaining your decisions; joining pre-sales calls with potential clients doesn't scare you

  • Initiative, ownership, and the kind of communication where people don't have to guess what you meant

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for wearables, health-tech, or smart audio

  • Motion design tools: After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar

  • Experience running or co-running brand design work

  • Familiarity with designer-developer handoff beyond the mockup: design tokens, variables, naming conventions

  • Genuine curiosity about the devices you design for, not just the interfaces on top of them

How we work

Fully remote with an office in Warsaw if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the UX/UI Design chapter for knowledge-sharing and growth, and simultaneously on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery, working alongside mobile and firmware engineers, QA, and UX designers.

What you'll get

  • 15,500-22,000 PLN net/month on B2B, depending on your experience

  • 26 days of paid leave

  • 10 days of paid sick leave

  • Saltus medical care

  • Training budget

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your own day

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy from the design team and take on progressively bigger tasks so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often; no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. We believe in fast, honest signals: if it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions and your portfolio

  2. Portfolio review

  3. HR call (~45 min, casual)

  4. Technical interview (30-60 min, with the design team)

  5. Final feedback

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV, your portfolio, and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you point us to the project you're most proud of and tell us why.

Tens of millions of people in the U.S. live with chronic financial insecurity, inadequate savings, and no meaningful wealth, with deeply harmful consequences for themselves, their children, families, communities, employers, and the economy. The EAP Care Manager is a mental health professional who provides telephonic and/or live chat support to members accessing the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role delivers brief clinical assessment, crisis intervention, solution-focused support, referral coordination, and workplace consultation services. The Care Manager ensures high-quality member experience while adhering to clinical best practices, confidentiality standards, and organizational workflows.

This position is full-time (40 hours/week) Monday - Friday. Applicants must be able to work the schedule below.

•Monday-Friday 11:30am-8pm ET

Pay Rate:

$28-35 per hour, commensurate with experience.

Job Summary

  • Provide telephonic and/or live chat needs assessment and screening while managing an inbound EAP phone/chat queue.
  • Deliver brief, solution-focused, in-the-moment supportive interventions and psychoeducation for concerns including stress, anxiety, grief, relationship issues, and substance use.
  • Conduct risk assessments for members presenting with concerns such as: suicidal ideation; thoughts of harm to others; substance use issues; risk for abuse or violence.
  • Provide crisis intervention and stabilization, including safety planning and connection to urgent or emergent resources when indicated.
  • Explain EAP clinical and work/life benefits and provide individualized recommendations to meet each member’s needs and goals.
  • Connect members to EAP services and/or health insurance or community resources and follow up to support successful engagement and connection to services, as clinically appropriate.
  • May provide consultation and support to HR and Managers regarding employee performance concerns, crisis support, or other issues within EAP scope, while maintaining professional boundaries and confidentiality.
  • May assist with Critical Incident Response following a Disruptive Event in the workplace, providing telephonic in-the-moment support to members and/or assisting with arranging onsite or virtual counseling at the worksite.
  • Document all interactions and activities accurately and timely in the electronic case management system.
  • Adhere to ethical standards, clinical best practices, and confidentiality requirements, including HIPAA and applicable regulations.
  • Participate in individual supervision, team meetings, and case consultation.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues to ensure high-quality member care.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Job Description:

Senior Front-End Product Engineer

React + UX + Data & AI Experiences

Build the front door to biomedical discovery.

LOCATION : Remote Eligible

CLEARANCE : Public Trust or ability to obtain one

MISSION PARTNER : National Institutes of Health

YOUR IMPACT

What happens when biomedical data, modern AI, and exceptional product craft meet? The hard thing becomes clear, fast, and trustworthy.

GDIT is looking for a senior front-end product engineer who can take an ambiguous mission problem from first conversation to production - and keep improving it after launch. This is an engineering-first role for someone who is equally comfortable interviewing users, sketching a flow, challenging a product assumption, designing an interaction model, and shipping a high-performance React application used by thousands of people or more.

You will build data-rich and AI-enabled mission applications for the National Institutes of Health. You will not simply receive a mockup and turn it into code. You will help define the product: personas, journeys, information architecture, prototypes, design system, front-end architecture, delivery plan, telemetry, and production operations. The work will deploy across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps.

Our goal: users should feel that a difficult mission workflow just became obvious.

THE ROLE

This role lives at the intersection of product design, UX research, front-end architecture, data visualization, AI interaction design, and cloud delivery. You will partner with NIH mission stakeholders, domain experts, product leaders, designers, data scientists, AI engineers, back-end engineers, and platform teams to decide what should be built and then make it real.

You will move fast, but not recklessly. You will use prototypes and evidence to reduce ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and take responsibility for the quality, accessibility, security, reliability, and impact of what reaches users.

This is not a handoff role. It is an ownership role.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

  • Lead human-centered discovery through interviews, contextual inquiry, workflow observation, task analysis, and collaborative workshops with mission users and stakeholders.
  • Turn research into clear personas, jobs-to-be-done, journey maps, service blueprints, information architecture, task flows, and product hypotheses.
  • Prototype at the speed of learning - from sketches and Figma concepts to high-fidelity coded prototypes - and use feedback to decide what deserves production investment.
  • Plan and facilitate usability studies, accessibility reviews, design critiques, and behavioral analysis; translate findings into prioritized product and engineering decisions.

Engineer the product

  • Architect and build production React and Next.js applications using TypeScript, the App Router, Server Components, Server Functions, streaming, modern caching, and intentionally small client-side boundaries.
  • Create responsive, adaptive, accessible interfaces using semantic HTML, modern CSS, Tailwind CSS, design tokens, accessible component primitives, and purposeful motion.
  • Build data-intensive experiences - dashboards, exploratory search, complex forms, virtualized tables, visual analytics, collaboration workflows, and real-time or streaming interfaces - without making users wrestle with the data model.
  • Design AI-native experiences such as copilots, RAG and agentic workflows, assisted analysis, and generative interfaces with streaming feedback, source attribution, provenance, clear limitations, human approval points, and graceful failure states.
  • Integrate GraphQL, REST and OpenAPI services, event streams, and back-end capabilities using generated types, runtime validation, resilient error handling, and secure authentication and authorization patterns.
  • Choose the right home for state - URL, server, component, form, or shared client state - and implement caching, synchronization, optimistic interaction, and recovery with discipline.
  • Build and evolve a reusable design system and component platform in Storybook so teams can ship consistent, accessible experiences faster.

Ship and operate

  • Own delivery from local development through production across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps, selecting managed, serverless, or container-based approaches that fit the mission and security context.
  • Automate build, test, security, and deployment pipelines; use infrastructure as code, dependency and supply-chain controls, feature flags, progressive delivery, and repeatable environment promotion.
  • Instrument the browser and application with logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, product analytics, and Core Web Vitals so the team can see what users experience and act on it.
  • Create a balanced quality strategy spanning unit, component, contract, accessibility, visual, performance, and end-to-end tests. Treat production reliability and incident learning as part of product quality.

Lead and elevate

  • Set a forward-looking front-end roadmap, document architectural decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and keep the platform modern without chasing novelty for its own sake.
  • Partner directly with users and leaders, explain complex technical choices clearly, invite dissent, and create alignment across design, product, data, AI, security, and engineering.
  • Mentor engineers and designers, lead design and code reviews, establish front-end quality standards, and create a paved road that improves delivery across the team.
  • Use AI-assisted design and development tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, coding, testing, documentation, and analysis while preserving human review, security, traceability, and engineering judgment.
  • Measure outcomes, not output: adoption, task success, time on task, error rates, accessibility, performance, reliability, user confidence, and mission value.

OUR MODERN FRONT-END TOOLBOX

This is a toolbox, not a trivia test. You do not need every library on this list. You do need deep React fundamentals, current hands-on expertise, and the judgment to choose - or reject - a technology for the right reasons.

Core React and language: React, Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Server Functions, React Compiler, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, semantic HTML, modern CSS, browser APIs, Web Workers, and package management with pnpm.

UI and design systems: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Base UI, React Aria or Radix UI, design tokens, Storybook, Figma, Motion, container queries, responsive and adaptive design, progressive enhancement, and component-driven development.

Data, state, and forms: GraphQL, REST, OpenAPI, GraphQL Code Generator, TanStack Query, Zod, URL state, local React state, Zustand or Jotai when shared client state is justified, React Hook Form, WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, and streaming data patterns.

Data visualization and scale: TanStack Table and Virtual, D3, Observable Plot, Vega-Lite, Apache ECharts, Canvas, WebGL or WebGPU when the workload calls for it, plus performance budgets, virtualization, code splitting, and efficient rendering of large datasets.

AI experience engineering: Streaming model responses, RAG and agentic interactions, tool execution, source attribution and provenance, human-in-the-loop controls, feedback and evaluation workflows, transparent limitations, and resilient UX for latency, partial results, and model failure.

Quality and accessibility: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Mock Service Worker, Storybook interaction and visual testing, automated accessibility checks, keyboard and screen-reader validation, WCAG, Section 508, and performance profiling.

Cloud and operations: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, Bicep or cloud development kits, Azure, AWS, Databricks Apps, OAuth and OpenID Connect, role- and attribute-based access control, OpenTelemetry, centralized logs, metrics and traces, error tracking, feature flags, and product analytics.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • 5 or more years of professional front-end or product engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of senior-level impact, including ownership of production React applications.
  • Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, browser behavior, component architecture, rendering, accessibility, and front-end performance.
  • A record of taking products from vision through discovery, design, implementation, deployment, support, and iterative improvement - not only contributing isolated tickets.
  • Experience shipping applications used by thousands of users or more, with practical knowledge of rollout, telemetry, reliability, support, performance, and change management at scale.
  • A portfolio or case studies that show human-centered design thinking, personas and flows, prototypes, architectural decisions, shipped software, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on skill conducting user research and usability testing, synthesizing ambiguous findings, and translating them into coherent interaction models and product decisions.
  • Experience building data-heavy, API-driven applications and making disciplined choices about server state, client state, caching, forms, validation, real-time updates, and error recovery.
  • Experience building or contributing to accessible design systems, reusable component libraries, and shared front-end standards.
  • Experience deploying and operating modern web applications in at least one major cloud environment, with the ability to work across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, technical leadership, curiosity, self-direction, and comfort making progress when the problem is not yet well defined.
  • Public Trust clearance, or the ability to obtain one.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Direct experience with Databricks Apps, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, model serving, lakehouse patterns, or governed data and AI applications.
  • Experience designing and shipping trustworthy AI products using RAG, multimodal models, agents, evaluation, source grounding, human review, and responsible AI patterns.
  • Experience with biomedical, scientific, clinical, research, or public-health data; familiarity with FAIR data principles, FHIR, data provenance, or research data governance.
  • Advanced data visualization experience involving high-dimensional, graph, temporal, geospatial, or very large datasets.
  • Experience with Web Workers, WebAssembly, Canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, local-first or offline-capable applications, or other advanced browser capabilities.
  • Experience with product experimentation, feature flags, A/B testing, product analytics, and outcome-based product development.
  • Experience delivering into secure or regulated federal environments, including Section 508, zero-trust identity, privacy, auditability, and DevSecOps controls.
  • A history of raising the bar through technical strategy, mentoring, design-system leadership, open-source contribution, or front-end platform enablement.

HOW WE'LL KNOW YOU'RE WINNING

  • Users can complete complex mission workflows faster, with fewer errors, less training, and greater confidence in the data and AI supporting their decisions.
  • The front-end platform becomes a force multiplier: reusable components, clear patterns, fast feedback, high-quality tests, and predictable deployments make the whole team more effective.
  • Applications are fast, accessible, secure, observable, reliable, and supportable across Azure, AWS, and Databricks Apps - not just impressive in a demo.
  • Production evidence and user feedback continuously shape the roadmap, and the team gets better at turning ambiguous mission needs into useful software.

THE MISSION: NIH

The National Institutes of Health seeks fundamental knowledge about living systems and applies that knowledge to enhance health, lengthen life, and reduce illness and disability. Learn about the NIH mission.

NIH's current direction for data science emphasizes new opportunities in software, computational methods and artificial intelligence, along with a federated biomedical research data infrastructure. You will help turn those capabilities into usable mission experiences - interfaces that help people explore evidence, understand data, collaborate, and act with confidence. Explore the NIH Strategic Plan for Data Science.

WHY GDIT

GDIT is a global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services across the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence community. Our work spans artificial intelligence, cloud, cyber, software development, and the mission systems that help create a safer, smarter world.

That culture is backed by GDIT's Emerge innovation centers and technology labs, where teams collaborate with customers and technology partners to rapidly prototype, test, and validate mission solutions across AI, cloud, cyber, software development, high-performance computing, and other emerging technologies. The goal is not a demo. It is mission-ready software in users' hands.

The culture we are building on this team is high ownership, direct collaboration, fast learning, thoughtful tradeoffs, and the freedom to turn a strong idea into a working product. We want someone who brings an informed point of view, listens hard, changes their mind when the evidence changes, and cares deeply about the people using what they build.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

  • Mission with meaning: build technology that supports biomedical research, public service, and better mission outcomes.
  • Autonomy with accountability: shape the product, the architecture, and the delivery approach - then own the result.
  • Technology at the edge of innovation: work across data, AI, cloud, UX, accessibility, and modern front-end engineering.
  • Growth and community: learn through technical communities, mentorship, certifications, professional development, and internal mobility.
  • A team that values clarity, curiosity, inclusion, constructive feedback, and excellent craft.

Not every strong candidate will match every item above. If you have deep React expertise, strong product judgment, and a record of shipping useful software, we would like to hear from you. Show us the work: a portfolio, case study, architecture walkthrough, or code sample that makes the users, tradeoffs, and outcomes visible.

jobs.title: Credit Risk Program Manager, Risk Foundations
jobs.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit team protects Stripe by managing the end-to-end risk of our largest and most complex users. We leverage deep underwriting expertise and data-driven stress heuristics to make informed decisions at every stage of the user lifecycle—from onboarding to loss recovery. Our goal is to enable Stripe's growth by making confident, calibrated decisions on our highest-exposure users.

What you’ll do

Stripe handles billions of dollars every year for businesses around the world, and the Risk team plays a critical role in the company's financial and partnership success. As a Credit Risk Analyst Commercial Underwriter on the North America Strategy Risk team, you'll underwrite and manage a portfolio of our largest and fastest-growing businesses to facilitate growth objectives while minimizing credit risk. This is a high-impact role that involves strong cross-functional partnership with Sales, Legal, Treasury, and Finance.

This role is assigned to West Coast hours, with a high preference for candidates in the Pacific time zone.

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with our top merchants, from successful venture-backed startups to well-established institutions, to evaluate their business models and financial statements
  • Provide tailored credit risk recommendations that mitigate Stripe exposure, while facilitating partner company growth
  • Help manage the portfolio by developing a deep understanding of risk across industries, geographies, and operating models
  • Deliver insights to support senior management decisions, ranging from onboarding strategies to merchant pricing analysis
  • Support the refinement of tools and processes to help the team deliver on key performance indicators, such as credit loss targets or portfolio coverage metrics
  • Work with internal and external partners to support merchants around the world

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience with knowledge of commercial credit underwriting, financial risk modeling, and cash flow forecasting
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, or other related fields
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and comfort evaluating financial statements and business models across a range of industries
  • Ability to transform business and financial data into cohesive narratives that outline potential credit risks and present dynamic mitigation strategies
  • Strong written, verbal, and problem-solving skills
  • Attention to detail while managing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to comfortably interact with the CFOs and CEOs of our top merchants
  • Deep empathy for entrepreneurs running a business, and motivation to solve problems to empower them

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong technical expertise, including demonstrated experience with SQL
  • Strong data visualization skills and a passion for data and analysis
  • Experience working in tech, or other fast-paced, high-growth environments

jobs.description:
Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. A true underwriting company, we have a 200-year history of helping our customers manage risk with laser-focused expertise, integrity and discipline. Our people are empowered to make decisions and problem-solve with you smartly and swiftly. Our annual gross written premium is 6.2 billion. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

Job Description

Since 2000, Crum & Forster’s Accident & Health division (A&H) has offered a diverse portfolio of specialty insurance and reinsurance products nationwide. We place a strong focus on product development and creative distribution methods, along with excellent client service and support.

In addition to our robust domestic portfolio, which spans both special risk and medical solutions, A&H works on an international basis through various partnerships. Our global capabilities provide our partners with even broader flexibility in underwriting solutions. Gross premium written in 2025 surpassed $2.4B.

The qualities and capabilities of Crum & Forster Accident & Health demonstrate our philosophy of building meaningful, long-term partnerships and our dedication to providing alternative strategies in an ever-changing insurance market.

Information about the Role, Line of Business and Team:

The Compliance Department is responsible for the submission of product filings (forms/rates/rules) to the respective state departments of insurance to support profitable business growth, as well as reviewing marketing materials for adherence to the various state unfair trade practices and advertising guidelines. In addition, the Compliance department works with the underwriting areas in ensuring that all policies and/or certificates are properly issued.

The Senior Compliance Analyst should be comfortable operating independently and in team-settings, and is responsible for drafting and filing policy forms, including benefit designs, schedules, and general provisions as well as reviewing advertising/marketing materials to ensure compliance with laws, regulations, and company guidelines, an all laws and regulations and are in accordance with our guidelines and ensuring consistency with product parameters and can identify and address problematic language, in line with current regulatory requirements and market standards. The Senior Compliance Analyst is responsible for the maintenance and regulatory compliance of assigned Accident & Health (A&H) and some Property & Casualty (P&C) products offered by Crum & Forster A&H Division.

What you will do:

  • Independently draft policy forms reflecting underwriting intent and consistent with regulatory requirements and current market standards for assigned lines of business, with support from Management where required
  • Manage complex product projects for assigned lines of business or products (admitted or non-admitted), collaborating with Underwriting, Claims, Legal, and Actuarial to produce final quality insurance products
  • Initiate and publish competitor filing information periodically and/or at request of Manager or business. Stay current on developments affecting marketing, product design, development, and filing requirements
  • Review and assess regulatory changes, including statutes, regulations, bulletins, and industry trends, to determine filing and regulatory requirements
  • Independently review advertising materials, including websites, to ensure compliance with internal standards and state regulatory guidelines, within established timeframes and utilizing tools available
  • Analyze with the ability to identify problematic language in marketing/advertisements as identified by guidelines applicable to that product
  • Develop issue instructions and translate approved filings into product fulfillment and ensure that the approved product is operationalized
  • Prepare, develop and issue policy contracts, amendments and related forms as needed for complex product structures, in accordance with company policy and state regulations
  • Respond to routine compliance-related requests and inquiries from the various business areas in a timely fashion
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal business units, external partners (such as TPAs and MGUs), and foster teamwork across the organization
  • Perform other related duties, including short- or long-term projects, as assigned by the manager
  • Other duties as assigned

What you will bring to C&F:

  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication as well as interpersonal skills
  • Flexible and open to an ever changing, fast-paced environment, based on the value of the business to the Division
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize and organize own work to meet deadlines
  • Meticulous with a high degree of accuracy and ability to multitask
  • Ability to manage conflict tactfully and effectively
  • Strong research, decision-making, and analytical skills

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of equivalent work experience in the insurance industry, ideally with direct exposure to one or more of the following A&H product lines: Travel, Ancillary Benefits, Stop Loss, Occupational Risk, Travel Medical, Special Risk, Pet, and/or Life Insurance
  • Demonstrated knowledge of insurance compliance laws and regulations; A&H Travel knowledge preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office software, including Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

If you require special accommodations, please let us know. Belonging at C&F, is a mindset. It’s about fostering a culture of inclusion and connection, where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive and where our social impact efforts help strengthen the communities where we live and work.

jobs.description:
At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

As an Algolia Install Base Account Executive, you will play a strategic and high-impact role, cultivating and expanding relationships with some of the most complex and innovative companies in the world. You should be comfortable researching prospects, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, and identifying new opportunities for expansion. Your ability to navigate global organizations and multi-brand portfolios will be key to delivering scalable solutions that drive long-term value across the entire organization.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, operates with autonomy, and brings a consultative approach to growing customer relationships.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of ~50 of our highest value customers, with accountability for retaining and growing revenue as customers move from early adoption to scale
  • Build trusted relationships with customers and develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives and use cases to proactively identify cross-sell opportunities across new teams, business units, or use cases, expanding Algolia's footprint within the account
  • Work in tandem with CSMs and CSEs to drive account planning and execution strategies that align Algolia’s solutions to customer goals, ensuring customers extract maximum value
  • Lead cross-sell strategy and commercial conversations with top accounts, expanding Algolia's presence across the organization
  • Monitor account health and usage to identify risks and mobilize account team on next best actions
  • Operate independently in a fast-evolving environment, helping shape sales motions and turn them into repeatable, scalable playbooks.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS sales or account management, with experience managing renewals and expansion in accounts with multiple stakeholders
  • Track record negotiating complex, multi-year enterprise agreements directly with customers and internal stakeholders (legal, finance, deal desk)
  • Strong collaboration skills with Customer Success, Solutions Engineers, and other cross-functional teams to proactively address customer needs, remove blockers, and to drive outcomes
  • Comfort managing complex, multi-stakeholder relationships within large organizations, with the strategic patience for longer sales cycles.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with SaaS, APIs, or developer-focused products
  • Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Background working with eCommerce or digital experience platforms

In practice, this looks like someone who:

  • Multi-threads across an account, engaging stakeholders from economic buyers to technical teams, with strategic questions that surface opportunities to expand Algolia into new teams, business units, or use cases
  • Consistently hits or exceeds renewal and expansion targets across your book of business
  • Runs a structured, multi-stakeholder account planning process across a concentrated portfolio of complex, high-value accounts, orchestrating CSMs, CSEs, and internal teams without losing momentum on longer sales cycles
  • Ramps quickly on complex technical products and can speak credibly to enterprise-scale architecture, how modern web and AI-native applications are built, scaled, and adopted across large organizations
  • Communicates effectively with both business stakeholders (e.g., merchandisers, Heads of eCommerce) and technical audiences, adapting approach and messaging accordingly

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range
$261,500—$285,000 USD

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:

  • GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.
  • TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.
  • CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.
  • CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.
  • HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

  • Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page.
  • All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an @algolia.com email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.
  • We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY?

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe.

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).

Who you are

This role is remote but requires candidates to be located in the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance. Proverbs 1:5

• Does it unite us? How?

Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely. I Corinthians 13:12

Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well. 3 John 1:2

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber is building the intelligence layer that will make our network self-aware — transforming raw telemetry from access, metro, and core into predictive diagnostics, proactive operations, and closed-loop automation. The Director of Network Intelligence owns this end-to-end: the telemetry architecture, the AI/ML diagnostic platforms, and the cross-layer data pipelines spanning OLT/ONT, residential gateway, Wi-Fi, metro Ethernet, and IP core.

This role also leads Ziply's Technology & Architecture Lab — our in-house environment for vendor evaluation, device certification, and proof-of-concept validation. You will build the lab into a world-class facility: securing vendor-donated equipment, accelerating certification cycles, and ensuring Ziply can evaluate and deploy new technology faster than any competitor in our market.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who has operated at scale — millions of managed devices, cross-domain telemetry platforms, and a track record of turning network data into measurable cost savings and customer experience improvements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Network Intelligence Platform

●Design and own the end-to-end telemetry architecture spanning access (OLT/ONT, residential gateway, Wi-Fi), metro Ethernet, and IP core — integrating network elements via gNMI, NETCONF/YANG, OMCI, and TR-069/CWMP into cloud analytics platforms (Calix Cloud or equivalent).

●Define data models for access and core network elements aligned with Broadband Forum standards (TR-069, TR-098, TR-143, TR-157, TR-181), OMCI for OLT/ONT management, gNMI/OpenConfig for core and metro telemetry streaming, and Wi-Fi analytics standards (802.11k/v/r, Wi-Fi 6/6E/7).

●Architect AI/ML-powered predictive diagnostic systems: anomaly detection, failure prediction, and proactive alerting across the full network stack — from in-home Wi-Fi through OLT/ONT to metro and core — to identify issues before subscriber impact.

●Build and own the remote diagnostics and troubleshooting platform: predictive, telemetry-driven architecture that measurably reduces unnecessary field dispatches and improves first-call resolution across access, Wi-Fi, and core network domains.

●Architect the microservices-based orchestration layer unifying backend systems and telemetry streams across GPON, XGS-PON, in-home gateways, metro, core, and FWA environments.

●Collaborate with the NOC and Pulse Autonomous Ops teams to operationalize model outputs into closed-loop automated workflows.

●Partner with IP Core & Metro and Transport architecture teams to extend network observability from the in-home gateway through the backbone.

Technology & Architecture Lab

●Build and operate Ziply's Technology & Architecture Lab — a state-of-the-art environment for vendor evaluation, device certification, and proof-of-concept testing across the network stack.

●Establish and grow a vendor-donated equipment program, securing lab hardware from strategic partners to expand certification capability without CapEx cost.

●Define and enforce the device and platform certification methodology: test plans, acceptance criteria, QA standards, and documentation requirements for new hardware and software deployments.

●Drive certification velocity — reduce cycle times through process improvement, parallel test tracks, and automated test tooling.

●Oversee annual device and platform certifications spanning OLT, ONT, CPE, residential gateways (TP-Link, Gemtek, eero, or equivalent), and core/metro platforms (Nokia, Juniper, Cisco, or equivalent).

●Manage lab vendor relationships and coordinate with product, operations, and field teams to ensure lab-validated technology translates to successful field deployments.

Team & Organization

●Lead cross-functional teams of engineers and vendor partners across intelligence, diagnostics, and lab operations.

●Drive vendor selection and TCO-based technology evaluations for analytics platforms, device management systems (Nokia HDM/ACS, Plume OpenSync, Assia, or equivalent), and lab infrastructure.

●Define data governance, retention, and quality standards for all network telemetry streams.

●Lead, coach, and develop engineers, technical leads, lab personnel, data/automation contributors, and vendor partners; establish priorities, decision rights, performance expectations, and delivery accountability.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

·12+ years of access, core network engineering, network intelligence, telemetry, diagnostics, automation, or related telecommunications technology experience, with deep expertise in GPON/XGS-PON, OLT/ONT architecture, Wi-Fi/CPE ecosystems, and IP/metro network environments at an ISP, CLEC, telecommunications provider, or related network environment.3-5+ years of progressive people leadership experience managing engineers, technical leads, lab personnel, data/automation contributors, vendor partners, or cross-functional technical teams.

·Expert-level Wi-Fi knowledge: in-home network architecture, 802.11ax/be (Wi-Fi 6/6E/7), mesh platforms, RF performance analytics, and gateway/CPE ecosystems (TP-Link, Gemtek, eero, or equivalent). Wi-Fi diagnostics and performance analytics must be a core strength.

·Proven track record designing and delivering unified telemetry and diagnostics platforms at scale — millions of managed devices — with measurable reductions in support costs and customer dispatch rates.

·Hands-on experience with network telemetry standards: gNMI/gRPC streaming telemetry, NETCONF/YANG, OMCI, OpenConfig, and Broadband Forum TR-069/CWMP, TR-098, TR-143, TR-157, TR-181.

·Experience with cloud analytics and device management platforms: Calix Cloud, Nokia HDM/ACS, Plume OpenSync, Assia, or equivalent.

·Working knowledge of AI/ML model development for network diagnostics: anomaly detection, predictive failure models, and log-analytics pipelines.

·Experience architecting microservices-based, cloud-ready orchestration layers that unify access and core telemetry with backend systems.

·Experience building or operating a technology lab or certification center — including vendor equipment programs, test methodology, and certification cycle management.

·Strong cross-functional leadership: able to align engineering, operations, vendors, and field teams around shared outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

●Experience extending network observability into metro and core domains: MPLS telemetry, BGP analytics, or transport performance monitoring on Nokia, Juniper, or Cisco platforms.

●Background in FWA (Fixed Wireless Access) platform architecture and carrier-agnostic LTE/5G CPE integration.

●Intellectual property development: patents in wireless performance analytics, network diagnostics, or device management.

●Experience supporting FTTP build-out programs at regional or national scale.

●Experience leading architecture, engineering, lab, data, or automation teams in a high-growth broadband, telecom, cloud, or network technology environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Strong people leadership and coaching skills with the ability to build teams, set priorities, develop technical talent, and create accountability for outcomes.

·Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to connect network intelligence capabilities to customer experience, operational efficiency, cost reduction, and business value.

·Executive presence and communication skills to influence Technology, Operations, Product, Field Operations, Customer Experience, Security, Legal, Finance, vendors, and senior leadership.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

Ziply Fiber is an equal opportunity employer. Ziply Fiber will consider all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, and the presence of a non-job-related handicap or disability or any other legally protected status.
