The Team:

The Product Marketing team at Turnitin is curious, customer-centric, data-driven, and collaborative. We’re responsible for the global go-to-market strategy for Turnitin’s portfolio of academic integrity and assessment solutions. The team collaborates cross-functionally with product management, corporate marketing, demand marketing, and global sales to develop positioning and messaging, content assets, campaigns, and sales tools in support of product revenue and customer engagement goals. The team is also responsible for competitive analysis and positioning.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced Product Marketing Manager to lead how we communicate our approach to data privacy, security, AI and data use, and accessibility to customers and the broader market.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Security, Privacy/Legal, AI, Accessibility, Sales, and Marketing. You will translate complex technical and policy topics into clear, credible, customer-friendly messaging that builds trust and helps customers understand how we protect their data, use AI responsibly, and design accessible products.

The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in product marketing, product management, technology marketing, or a related field, preferably within B2B SaaS, education technology, enterprise software, or another highly regulated or trust-sensitive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear market-facing positioning and messaging for data privacy, security, AI data use, responsible AI practices, and accessibility across our product portfolio.
  • Communicate How We Use Customer Data: Clearly articulate how customer and user data is collected, processed, stored, protected, retained, and used within our products, partnering closely with Privacy, Legal, Security, and Product teams to ensure accuracy.
  • Lead AI Transparency Communications: Own customer-facing communications explaining where and how AI is used across our products, what data AI features access, how that data is handled, and whether and under what circumstances customer data is used to train or improve AI models.
  • Maintain External Trust & Transparency Resources: Own and continuously improve external-facing web content and resources that provide customers with easy-to-understand information about our security, privacy, AI, data-use, and accessibility practices.
  • Translate Technical Concepts for Customers: Turn complex security architectures, privacy practices, AI technologies, accessibility standards, and regulatory requirements into language that customers, educators, administrators, procurement teams, and business leaders can readily understand.
  • Enable Sales and Customer-Facing Teams: Develop training, playbooks, FAQs, objection-handling guidance, presentations, and talk tracks that help Sales, Customer Success, and other customer-facing teams confidently discuss security, privacy, AI data use, and accessibility.
  • Support Customer and Procurement Conversations: Partner with Sales, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Product teams to address common customer questions and concerns arising during evaluations, procurement processes, security reviews, and renewals.
  • Create a Consistent Source of Truth: Establish and maintain approved messaging so that Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Privacy, and Security communicate consistently about these topics.
  • Partner on Product Launches: Ensure new products and features—particularly those involving AI or new uses of customer data—have appropriate trust, privacy, security, and accessibility messaging as part of launch readiness.
  • Drive Proactive Customer Communication: Identify emerging topics that may create customer questions or concerns and develop proactive communications before they become barriers to adoption or renewal.
  • Monitor the Market and Regulatory Landscape: Stay informed about evolving expectations and regulations related to AI, privacy, security, and accessibility and help translate those developments into implications for product positioning and customer communication.
  • Represent the Voice of the Customer: Bring recurring customer questions and concerns back to Product, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Accessibility teams to influence product decisions, policies, documentation, and roadmap priorities.

What success looks like:

Customers can quickly understand how we protect their data, how AI is used in our products, whether their data is used to train AI models, and how we approach accessibility. Sales and Customer Success teams can confidently answer these questions without unnecessarily escalating routine inquiries, and our external communications consistently reinforce trust in our products and company.

  • 5–7 years of experience in product marketing, product management, technology marketing, or a related B2B SaaS role.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate highly technical or regulated topics into clear, compelling customer-facing communications.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal/Privacy, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS data privacy and security concepts; familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and accessibility is highly desirable.
  • Experience developing sales enablement programs, messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive materials, or customer-facing product documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable navigating topics where technical capabilities, regulatory requirements, customer expectations, and market positioning intersect.
  • Ability to build credibility with technical and legal subject-matter experts while maintaining a strong customer and commercial perspective.

jobs.excerpt: Waar jouw werk het verschil maakt in het dagelijks leven van gezinnen.
jobs.description:
Waar jouw werk het verschil maakt in het dagelijks leven van gezinnen.

Functieomschrijving

Goede zorg staat of valt met goed opgeleide mensen die die zorg verlenen. Als opleidingsadviseur ben jij hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met leren en ontwikkelen te maken heeft bij ‘t Kabouterhuis. Jij vertaalt de visie van de organisatie naar concrete opleidings- en ontwikkelinitiatieven.

Wat ga je doen?

Je brengt scholingsbehoeften in kaart en denkt actief mee over deskundigheidsbevordering, onder andere gericht op SKJ/BIG-registraties, interprofessioneel samenwerken en strategische kennisontwikkeling. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan een lerende organisatie waarin medewerkers zich continu kunnen ontwikkelen.

In deze veelzijdige rol houd je je onder andere bezig met de vertaling van organisatiedoelstellingen naar een meerjarenopleidingsplan, jaarlijkse opleidingsplannen voor de locaties en het mede ontwikkelen van een toekomstgerichte visie op intern opleiden en praktijkbegeleiding (van HBO tot postdoctoraal). Je monitort en analyseert opleidingsdata en doet beleidsaanbevelingen. Daarnaast weet je alles van ons het learning management systeem en draag je vanuit jouw expertise bij aan een sterk onboardingsprogramma.

Requirements

Bij ’t Kabouterhuis hebben we allemaal dezelfde drijfveer: het jonge kind en hun ouders. Begeleiden in die eerste kwetsbare stappen maakt ons werk zo waardevol. Dat is waarom we dit doen.

Onze teams zijn bevlogen, multidisciplinair en staan altijd naast elkaar én naast ouders. Samenwerken is bij ons niet slechts een lege term, maar onderdeel van hoe we elke dag met elkaar werken. Dat maakt dat mensen jarenlang bij ’t Kabouterhuis blijven werken. Je komt terecht in een warme, betrokken groep professionals waar gelijkwaardigheid de standaard is en je altijd kunt terugvallen op collega’s.

Je hebt

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau in een relevante richting zoals HRD/HRM of arbeids- of organisatiepsychologie

  • Inzicht in ontwikkelingen op het vakgebied Learning en Development, kennis van eigentijdse leervormen zoals blended learning en digitale leer- en ontwikkeloplossingen (o.a. LMS)

  • Het in je om operationeel overzicht te houden en strategisch mee te denken

  • Ervaring met organisatieverandering en implementatieprocessen bij voorkeur in binnen zorg, jeugdzorg of GGZ

  • Ervaring met het faciliteren van reflectie, intervisie en lerende netwerken is een pre

Wat je bij ons krijgt

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 9 (€3309 tot €4943 bruto p/m op basis van fulltime)

  • Een dienstverband van circa 24 uur per week

  • Een vakantietoeslag 8% én eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%

  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten en een fietsenplan

  • De ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen

  • Een bevlogen team dat altijd naast je staat

De doelgroep – wat ons werk het mooiste werk maakt!

Het hele jonge kind, daar moet je echt voor willen gaan. Je werkt met gezinnen die erg kwetsbaar zijn en veel meemaken. Met alle disciplines samen puzzel je aan het totaalbeeld: wat speelt er écht? En wat hebben dit jonge kind en de directe omgeving nodig? Dat maakt het werk uitdagend, verdiepend en ontzettend betekenisvol. 

De Infant Mental Health (IMH) visie vormt het uitgangspunt van hoe wij werken, samenwerken en behandelen. Vanuit die visie blijven we leren en ons samen ontwikkelen. We zien het jonge kind altijd in de context waarin het opgroeit: de relatie met ouders, het netwerk en de omgeving. Dat vraagt om een systemische blik, een open houding en veel kennis van ontwikkeling, hechting en regulatie.

Klaar om samen het verschil te maken voor het jonge kind?

jobs.description:
Você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer construir soluções que realmente importam? Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que há mais de 30 anos é líder global em planejamento inteligente.

Combinamos otimização, análises avançadas, inteligência geoespacial e IA para entregar soluções que transformam cadeias de suprimentos e promovem a sustentabilidade em setores como o florestal e industrial. Nossa tecnologia ajuda empresas a tomar melhores decisões, aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar um crescimento sustentável em um mundo em constante transformação.

Se você quer atuar em um ambiente inovador, colaborativo e com impacto global, essa oportunidade é para você.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

📍 Sobre a vaga

A Remsoft está em busca de um(a) Analista de FP&A para integrar o time. A posição atua em conjunto com as operações do Brasil, Canadá e Austrália, reportando diretamente à liderança financeira no Canadá. É uma função analítica e estratégica: seu foco principal é entender a saúde financeira do negócio através da receita recorrente, projetar crescimento e apoiar decisões de investimento e expansão — não a rotina operacional financeira do dia a dia, que já é conduzida por outras áreas. Você será parceiro(a) estratégico(a) da liderança e do time Comercial e Marketing, traduzindo dados complexos em insights que orientam decisões de negócio.

Este não é um perfil operacional: não fazem parte do escopo desta vaga rotinas como emissão de nota fiscal, contas a pagar/receber, conciliação bancária ou controle contábil, essas atividades já são conduzidas por outras equipes.

🎯 Fará parte do seu dia a dia:

  • Analisar receita recorrente e não recorrente (ARR/MRR), acompanhando churn, downsell e upsell para entender o que está impulsionando ou reduzindo o valor do negócio
  • Compreender e aplicar a lógica de valuation baseada em receita recorrente
  • Trabalhar em parceria estratégica com o time Comercial, entendendo pipeline, prospecção de vendas e traduzindo isso em projeções de receita recorrente e não recorrente
  • Analisar o comportamento da receita por cliente, identificando motivos de alta ou queda no faturamento e o impacto nos resultados da empresa
  • Liderar o ciclo de orçamento anual e as previsões contínuas (rolling forecast), coordenando os insumos das unidades de negócio
  • Construir e manter modelos financeiros multicenário para planejamento, casos de negócio e avaliação de investimentos
  • Apoiar planos financeiros de longo prazo (3 a 5 anos), com projeções de receita, headcount, capex e fluxo de caixa
  • Colaborar com a liderança sênior para modelar cenários estratégicos, como fusões, aquisições, expansão de mercado e reestruturação
  • Monitorar KPI's financeiros e de receita, apresentando recomendações de forma clara para públicos não financeiros
  • Desenvolver dashboards com visibilidade em tempo real sobre desempenho comercial e financeiro
  • Manter fluxos financeiros no Salesforce e garantir a integridade dos dados
  • Colaborar com TI e Operações em melhorias de sistemas, integrações e processos

🎯 Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Finanças, Economia, Contabilidade ou área relacionada
  • 3 ou mais anos de experiência progressiva em FP&A, análise financeira estratégica ou revenue operations — não em rotina financeira operacional
  • 1 ou mais ano de experiência no setor de tecnologia ou software (SaaS), com entendimento prático de métricas de receita recorrente
  • Conhecimento sólido em orçamento, modelagem financeira de longo prazo e análise de variações
  • Vivência analisando receita recorrente, churn e comportamento de carteira de clientes
  • Experiência trabalhando em conjunto com times de Vendas e Marketing
  • Experiência prática com Salesforce, para relatórios de pipeline e comerciais
  • Inglês fluente, escrito e falado, para colaboração com as equipes globais da Remsoft
  • Proficiência avançada em Excel e/ou Google Sheets

Etapa em inglês: o processo seletivo inclui uma entrevista conduzida integralmente em inglês.

💡 Perfil e competências

  • Perfil analítico com viés econômico e estratégico
  • Comunicação clara, com facilidade para traduzir conceitos financeiros complexos para diferentes públicos
  • Curiosidade para investigar o "porquê" por trás dos números, não só reportar o que aconteceu
  • Capacidade de gerenciar prioridades concorrentes e múltiplas entregas simultâneas
  • Perfil colaborativo e orientado a servir o negócio

✔️ Será um plus se você possuir

The Controller – Corporate Accounting leads BELAY's Corporate Accounting function and is responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of the organization's financial reporting and accounting operations. This role oversees the Corporate Accounting Team, manages the monthly close process, ensures compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and partners closely with Finance leadership to support budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and strategic decision-making.

The Controller serves as a trusted financial leader, driving operational excellence, strengthening internal controls, and continuously improving accounting processes to support the organization's long-term success.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate Accounting Team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance coaching, and professional development conversations with direct reports.
  • Plan, prioritize, and delegate work assignments while providing technical guidance and removing barriers to team success.
  • Establish and monitor departmental goals, key metrics, and performance expectations.
  • Provide recommendations for process improvements, technology enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance on strategic initiatives and departmental planning.

Financial Reporting & Accounting Operations

  • Oversee the general ledger and ensure accurate recording of income, expenses, and financial transactions.
  • Ensure timely reconciliation of balance sheet accounts and review monthly account reconciliations.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, including maintaining close calendars and reporting deadlines.
  • Monitor working capital accounts, including cash, receivables, payables, accrued liabilities, and fixed assets.
  • Prepare and compile monthly financial statements for leadership and shareholder reporting.
  • Support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc financial analyses.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and BELAY accounting policies.
  • Oversee annual external audits and coordinate audit documentation and support.
  • Maintain the integrity of accounting systems, financial data, and related system integrations.
  • Strengthen internal controls and identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and operational efficiency.

Cash Management & Business Partnership

  • Monitor daily cash position and organizational liquidity.
  • Partner with FP&A to support forecasting, planning, and financial analysis.

  • Partner with system administrators to implement system enhancements and improve accounting workflows.

  • Experience leading accounting operations and improving financial processes.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to coach, develop, and manage a high-performing team.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of integrity and ability to manage confidential financial information.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and accounting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA designation.

  • Experience working in a remote or distributed organization.

Skills & Competencies

  • Financial reporting and accounting expertise.
  • Leadership and people development.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen.
  • Analytical and critical thinking.
  • Process improvement and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Project and time management.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Sound judgment and decision-making.

Project Engineer – Renewable Energy and Energy storage systems

  • Perform solar resource assessments and energy production estimates with PVsyst and other optimization tools.
  • Support, from a technical point of view, the procurement phase (request for proposal, contract negotiation, qualification) with OEM, suppliers and BoP/EPC Contractors.

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous Renewable Energy experience.
  • Previous WTG experience
  • Technical Project Management experience – Advantage
  • Experience in the technical contractual phase for renewable energy Plants
  • Familiarity with Project Development is preferrable
  • Experience in high voltage connections and sub-stations design – Significant advantage
  • Software: WindPro (Advantage), PVsyst, Autocad, Microsoft Office suite, Word and Excel.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills

jobs.excerpt: Who we're looking forWe're looking for a product designer who can take a problem from an early, unclear state through to a working prototype, and who builds those prototypes themselves.
jobs.description:
Who we're looking for

We're looking for a product designer who can take a problem from an early, unclear state through to a working prototype, and who builds those prototypes themselves.

Three requirements matter most. High ownership, meaning you drive a problem to a result without being managed through it. Product thinking, meaning you can state the customer problem precisely and be specific about what in your solution addresses it and why you expect that to work. And building prototypes yourself, so that something real and testable exists without waiting for engineering. Design craft is assumed. These three are what the role actually depends on.

What the role covers

The role sits on SmartyMe, our mobile educational app, and covers five areas:

  1. Own problems rather than tasks.
    Work usually arrives as a problem, not a detailed spec from a product manager. You'd be responsible for understanding why, deciding what to do, and carrying it through discovery, design, prototype, launch, and measurement.
  2. Product thinking.
    Getting to a precise statement of what the user is actually struggling with, using user conversations, data, and the product itself. Then being specific about which part of your solution addresses that problem and why you expect it to work, rather than presenting a design and reasoning backwards from it. Knowing what you're solving is the part that decides whether the rest of the work matters.
  3. Build working prototypes yourself.
    We prototype with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Replit or whatever you work fastest in. The aim is something users can actually use within days, without waiting for engineering capacity. This is a core part of the job rather than an occasional extra.
  4. Hypotheses and metrics, not only design.
    You'd own specific product branches together with the hypotheses behind them, and work with the PM as a peer rather than as a service function. In practice that means naming the metric you expect to move before you start, and being the person who knows afterwards whether it moved. Branch activation and branch cancel rate are what we're currently judged on.
  5. Neat and clean design solutions.
    We care about solutions that are simple and consistent: sensible structure, careful spacing and typography, states and edge cases handled, and nothing on the screen that doesn't need to be there. Speed of building doesn't excuse a sloppy interface.

What's in the role for you

  • A team to learn from. The product team is experienced and includes people who previously worked at Miro, Palta, Uber, and Bolt. Everyone here runs their own initiatives, so the people around you already work the way this role asks you to. At this size you'd be in the room when product decisions get made rather than hearing the outcome later, and you'd get direct feedback on your thinking from people who have done this at larger scale.
  • Shaping mobile learning in a product with more than a million users. SmartyMe is live and used daily, so the changes you make show up in the numbers within days rather than quarters. Very few designers get to work at that scale of feedback on something they own outright.
  • Freedom to test hypotheses. If you can prototype it, you can test it. You don't need to assemble consensus or wait for a planning cycle to try an idea, and production has clear risk guardrails rather than blanket approvals.
  • Broad scope for one seat. Design, product decisions, and building in a single role. It's a rare combination to practise in one place, and the three skills compound rather than compete.
  • A short path to decisions. You'd report directly to the VP of Product and partner with a strong product manager, with no layers between your work and the people who decide. AI tools are part of how we work rather than a side experiment.

Technical skills

3+ years of product design including mobile apps.

  • Product design experience: hands-on work on real products, ideally mobile-first consumer apps. EdTech, wellness, or habit-building products are a plus.
  • Prototyping with AI tools: you build working prototypes yourself in Claude Code, Codex, Replit, or similar. This is a requirement. Pushing small production changes is a plus, not an expectation.
  • Product and metrics literacy: you can express work as a hypothesis, covering what should change, roughly how much, and what would indicate you were wrong.
  • AI features: comfortable designing around AI-powered functionality and hypotheses that keep shifting.
  • Figma: components, auto layout, variants, prototyping, versioning.

Nice to have: activation and retention work, games or content-heavy products, design systems, something you've shipped independently.

How you work

These carry as much weight in our decision as the technical skills above.

  • Ownership (the primary requirement). You take a problem and stay accountable for the outcome, not for the hand-off. That means deciding without full information, unblocking yourself, chasing the people you need, and reporting where things stand before anyone asks. The team is compact and nobody will be managing you through the steps.
  • Proactivity. Identifying what needs doing and starting it, rather than waiting for the problem to be assigned and defined. A meaningful share of the work you do here will be work you proposed.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Problems arrive underdefined, and turning them into something workable is part of the job rather than a prerequisite for starting it.
  • Preference for shipping. Getting to a rough working version early rather than extending the planning stage.
  • Attention to craft. Spacing, clarity, copy, and the details in between.
  • Direct communication. Explaining design decisions openly in Slack, Figma, and live sessions, raising problems early, and disagreeing when you think a decision is wrong.
  • Learning speed. We weight rate of improvement more heavily than years of experience.

Hiring process

  1. Portfolio screening. We look at how you framed problems and what came out of them, including the parts that didn't go smoothly. Cases with the reasoning shown tell us more than a set of finished screens.
  2. Recruiter screening. Basics, level, motivation, and logistics.
  3. Job and partnership fit interview (45 min). With the SmartyMe product manager, the person you'd work with most closely. The actual work of the role and how the two of you would divide and share it.
  4. Team fit interview (45 to 60 min). With the VP of Product. Your background and product thinking, mostly through specific cases: something you initiated yourself, something you owned end to end, and something you decided without enough information.
  5. Live working session (60 to 90 min). The final and main stage. We bring a real SmartyMe problem with incomplete data and no spec. We narrow it together, form a hypothesis, and you build something during the session using your own tools. We're interested in the reasoning and in how quickly you get to something real, not in a finished answer.

Operations Coordinator (KPI Reporting, SOPs & Cross-Functional Operations) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Operations Coordinator to keep day-to-day business operations organized, visible, and moving efficiently across multiple departments.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows, tracking performance, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring teams follow through on operational priorities.

You’ll work across functions including:

  • Operations
  • Finance
  • HR
  • Customer Service
  • Logistics
  • IT
  • Vendor Management

You’ll serve as a key coordination point between teams while giving leadership clear visibility into KPIs, deadlines, risks, and operational performance.

What You’ll Own

Process & Workflow Coordination

  • Track operational workflows across multiple departments.
  • Monitor tasks, deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Ensure recurring processes are completed according to established SOPs.
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding action items.
  • Identify bottlenecks, delays, and operational gaps before they become larger issues.
  • Escalate risks when necessary and help maintain execution consistency.

KPI Tracking & Operational Reporting

  • Maintain operational dashboards, trackers, and reporting systems.
  • Prepare:
    • Weekly operational reports
    • Monthly KPI summaries
    • Leadership updates
    • Performance insights
  • Track metrics including:
    • Productivity
    • Utilization
    • Workflow completion
    • Operational efficiency
  • Ensure data is accurate, current, and actionable.
  • Help leadership understand operational performance and areas requiring attention.

Documentation & SOP Management

  • Create, maintain, and update:
    • SOPs
    • Process maps
    • Operational checklists
    • Compliance documentation
  • Maintain organized records within systems such as:
    • Google Drive
    • SharePoint
    • Notion
  • Ensure documentation is easy to find, current, and audit-ready.
  • Help standardize recurring operational processes.

Vendor & Partner Coordination

  • Communicate with vendors and external partners regarding:
    • Deliverables
    • Timelines
    • Invoices
    • Service updates
  • Monitor vendor commitments and SLAs.
  • Follow up on outstanding requirements.
  • Escalate delays or performance issues proactively.
  • Maintain organized vendor documentation and approvals.

Cross-Functional Operations Support

  • Coordinate recurring workflows between departments.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on deadlines and responsibilities.
  • Support leadership with:
    • Operational research
    • Reporting
    • Analysis
    • Ad hoc initiatives
  • Help maintain clear communication and accountability across teams.

Compliance & Operational Controls

  • Ensure operational activities align with established company processes and requirements.
  • Maintain accurate logs, records, and tracking systems.
  • Support audit readiness through organized documentation.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent operational information.
  • Help maintain strong internal controls and process discipline.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Thrive on structure, organization, and accountability.
  • Notice operational gaps before others do.
  • Follow through consistently without requiring constant supervision.
  • Are comfortable coordinating across multiple departments.
  • Can balance recurring workflows with urgent priorities.
  • Enjoy working with data, trackers, and operational reporting.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Look for ways to make processes more efficient and reliable.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, business coordination, administrative operations, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Office
    • Google Workspace
    • Excel / Google Sheets
  • Strong spreadsheet skills including:
    • Pivot tables
    • KPI tracking
    • Dashboards
    • Operational reporting
  • Experience with business systems such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • NetSuite
    • Similar CRM/ERP platforms
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience creating and maintaining SOPs.
  • Exposure to process improvement methodologies such as:
    • Lean
    • Six Sigma
    • Kaizen
  • Familiarity with:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
  • Experience supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • Logistics businesses
    • Professional services
    • Service-based organizations
  • Experience working across multiple departments or business functions.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing workflow progress across departments.
  • Following up on overdue tasks and deliverables.
  • Updating KPI dashboards and operational reports.
  • Coordinating with vendors on timelines or outstanding items.
  • Updating SOPs and process documentation.
  • Reviewing data for inconsistencies or missing information.
  • Preparing leadership updates.
  • Supporting cross-functional operational initiatives.
  • Escalating bottlenecks or risks before they affect execution.

In short: you keep operations organized, measurable, visible, and moving forward.

Key Metrics for Success

  • On-time completion of operational workflows.
  • Accurate and timely KPI reporting.
  • Minimal missed deadlines or coordination gaps.
  • Zero missed vendor or operational obligations.
  • Current and audit-ready SOPs and documentation.
  • Timely identification and escalation of bottlenecks.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and follow-through.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High visibility across multiple areas of the business.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and operational teams.
  • Exposure to:
    • Operations management
    • KPI reporting
    • Process improvement
    • Vendor management
    • Cross-functional coordination
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Strong ownership over operational execution.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Operations Coordinator
    • Operations Manager
    • Project Manager
    • Business Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Task — KPI Dashboard or Process Tracker Exercise
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

jobs.description:
Join Us in Bringing Hope to Life

Our purpose is to bring hope to life by enabling life‑changing therapies for patients around the globe, creating a healthier and happier tomorrow. To advance this purpose, we rely on team members who value excellence, collaboration, and meaningful work. If this resonates with you, we invite you to explore the role further and apply.

Job Summary

We are seeking a (Senior) Director of Business Development to join our Global Business Development organization and drive strategic growth within our Microbial and Mammalian business segment. Reporting to the Global Head of Business Development, this role plays a critical part in expanding AGC Biologics’ footprint by identifying, evaluating, and closing new development and manufacturing partnerships across the United States.

The Senior Director builds strong, consultative relationships with prospective clients, shaping high‑value opportunities and contributing to the advancement of next‑generation therapies. This position offers the opportunity to influence commercial strategy, collaborate with global cross-functional partners, and create meaningful impact in a fast‑moving, complex CDMO environment.

About Our Business Development Team

You’ll join a highly collaborative global team that partners closely across technical, legal, marketing, and operational functions to support customers throughout the full development and manufacturing lifecycle. Our team operates in a dynamic, growth‑oriented environment where strategic thinking, relationship building, and commercial excellence drive success. We focus on delivering high‑quality opportunities aligned with our mission to bring hope to life through biopharmaceutical innovation.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, engage, and close new microbial development and manufacturing partnerships across the U.S.

  • Build and maintain strategic client relationships that expand market presence and drive revenue growth.

  • Develop and execute a targeted sales territory plan aligned with annual commercial goals.

  • Effectively communicate AGC Biologics’ technical and operational capabilities to key decision‑makers within prospective organizations.

  • Lead and coordinate client site visits, including agenda planning, cross-functional engagement, and structured follow‑up.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to shape strategies and materials supporting U.S. commercial initiatives.

  • Manage pipeline activity within CRM systems to ensure accuracy, visibility, and timely follow‑up.

  • Partner with global cross‑functional teams—including Technical Operations, Legal, Finance, and Program Management—to advance opportunities through due diligence and contract execution.

  • Provide meaningful market insights based on customer interactions, competitive dynamics, and industry trends.

  • Represent AGC Biologics at conferences, trade shows, and relevant industry events.

  • Consistently deliver high‑quality opportunities aligned with company growth strategies and leadership expectations.

Your Leadership & Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical, strategic, and communication skills with the ability to distill complex information into clear messaging.

  • Focused on value creation, with the ability to prioritize and execute on the highest‑impact opportunities.

  • Highly organized and resourceful, capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

  • Skilled at tailoring communication styles to diverse stakeholders and delivering compelling presentations.

  • Customer‑focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and high-quality engagements.

  • Collaborative and team‑oriented, operating in alignment with AGC Biologics’ Core Values: Knowledge, Trust, Quality, Ingenuity, Accountability, and Teamwork.

  • Committed to continuous improvement and commercial excellence.

Your Experience & Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of successful business development or sales experience, preferably within the CDMO or broader life sciences/biopharmaceutical sector.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated success in developing relationships, presenting to senior leadership, and closing complex technical solutions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to various audiences.

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% for client meetings, industry events, and internal engagements.

Formalities

Location: Remote in the San Francisco Bay Area
Schedule: Full-time
Travel: ~50% domestic, with occasional international travel
Compensation Range: $164,400 - $266,750

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in the United States. From our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market. 

We are a collaborative, inclusive, and equal‑opportunity organization where team members are valued for their expertise, teamwork, and ingenuity.

  • 4–7 years of experience in M365 platform engineering (SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Entra ID).

  • Familiarity with environment provisioning workflows, security groups, licensing models, and ServiceNow intake processes.
  • Strong understanding of identity, conditional access, and M365 security baselines.
  • Experience managing enterprise‑scale tenants, integrations, and governance models.
  • Ability to work across technical and business teams, driving standards, clarity, and secure design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or supporting Copilot and AI‑enabled M365 workloads.
  • Knowledge of Power App governance, Power Platform COE toolkit, or Dynamics 365 integration.
  • Experience with scripting (PowerShell, Graph API) and automation frameworks.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. You will serve as the primary strategic partner for your clients on a day-to-day basis, owning the narrative around performance, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring all marketing efforts ladder up to business objectives. A successful candidate is a strong cross-channel marketer and communicator who can confidently translate data into insights, guide internal teams, and build trust with clients. This is a critical role in ensuring accounts are not only running efficiently, but driving meaningful business impact.

As an Associate Account Director (AAD), you will act as the day-to-day strategic lead for CPG clients, ensuring marketing efforts are aligned to revenue growth across DTC, retail, and Amazon ecosystems—not just individual channel performance. You will work closely with client stakeholders across eCommerce, retail, and brand teams, helping navigate tradeoffs between channels, product launches, and campaign strategy. This role requires comfort discussing channel mix, retail dynamics, Amazon performance, and omnichannel measurement. You’ll partner with Project Managers to ensure execution stays on track, while collaborating with the Account Director to refine quarterly strategy and long-term growth plans.

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Lead weekly client calls on larger accounts; support PM-led calls on smaller accounts — own the performance narrative either way
  • Translate Power Circuit roadmap outputs into weekly account priorities; flag when execution is drifting from the strategy
  • Track performance across DTC, retail media, and Amazon ecosystems; identify cross-channel dynamics and surface insights to the client and AD
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a unified account strategy
  • Advise on channel mix and investment allocation across DTC, retail, and Amazon; flag when channels are cannibalizing rather than reinforcing each other
  • Support the AD on quarterly strategy, renewal prep, and service expansion conversations
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships; contribute to ≥90% retention across your accounts
  • Work in Iris and nova daily; use performance data to surface issues before clients raise them; maintain Pulse cadence at 100%

  • 4–7 years in CPG, eCommerce, or retail marketing, with experience managing client relationships day-to-day
  • Familiar with the CPG channel landscape: DTC, retail media, and Amazon basics — ASIN architecture, sponsored vs. organic, retail partner dynamics
  • Understands omnichannel measurement at a working level — knows what MMM and incrementality testing are and when they matter

  • Comfortable presenting to director and VP-level stakeholders, including brand-strong clients who have opinions that predate the data
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can translate complex channel dynamics into a clear client narrative

By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Overview

An Architect in the Professional Services, Accounting organization is responsible for implementing PowerPlan’s solutions to meet specific customer requirements. This position is expected to take on implementation projects of increasing challenge and complexity. Typically, the Architect will run the majority of design sessions, and in the case of the largest and most complex projects will defer to the guidance of a Solution Advisor. The Architect will be involved through a full project and is typically heaviest during design.

They may hold the Solution Architect or Functional Lead project roles and will have a strong background in Utilities/Financial ERP software implementations for external clients. We would also consider candidates with ERP Accounting software implementation experience.

Responsibilities

Key Performance Objectives

Project Leadership: Actively lead a project team (including clients, colleagues, other consultants, vendors, etc.) and complete tasks and activities in accordance with PowerPlan’s methodology, adhering to project schedules and budgetary constraints. Provide early notice of any potential risks or issues with respect to adherence to project schedules or budgets.

Consultative Skills: Contribute and share application and domain/industry expertise and functional knowledge, demonstrating advanced consultative skills. Assist the Project Manager in planning for future project phases, tasks, events, and resources.

Design and Configuration: Lead the majority of design sessions and enable the functional lead role to stretch as a lead in some instances. Gather and analyze client requirements to determine the design of the to-be delivered solution, ensuring it is based on the approved requirements and per the SOW. Work closely with the Technical team members as appropriate. Develop specifications documents for report, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms, and configurations. Responsible for ensuring a solid hand-off of design to the project team.

Quality Assurance and Testing: Responsible for the quality assurance (QA) protocols for Professional Services solution design, development, and deployment. Define test plans and procedures, assist with the development of use and test cases, manage and, where appropriate, conduct unit, system, and integration testing from a quality assurance and support of project team perspective. Manage and support the client’s User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Application Go-live and Cutover: Support application go-live and cutover, provide knowledge transfer to clients, and ensure the client staff are ready to operate the application upon go-live. Assist clients in transitioning the application to the client’s production support team. Plan and execute effective hand-off to PowerPlan’s Support organization. Identify client skill or knowledge gaps that might be addressed via PowerPlan’s training organization and/or an enhanced support model. Cutover planning and support.

Domain/Industry Expertise: Demonstrate and use application-wide domain/industry-specific expertise. Ensure other project team members are developing this expertise with guidance as well.

Business Development: Assist in and lead the business development cycle activities by providing domain/industry subject matter expertise to potential clients and sales personnel.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5-9 years’ experience implementing enterprise software applications in a client-facing consulting role; preferably in a software consulting or IT type organization
  • Experience in most phases of the implementation process (minimum of 3)
  • Experience with utilizing a robust implementation methodology
  • History of increasing responsibility or upward progression
  • Experience leading project teams or direct reports.
  • Able to track multiple independent work items simultaneously.
  • Ability to establish oneself as a trusted advisor to client, project team and PowerPlan, Inc. colleagues.
  • High level of collaboration skills, especially with co-workers or subject matter experts not in the same location
  • Excellent, effective communication skills, including:
  • verbal, written, listening and presentation skills
  • ability to engage and successfully interact with the client and project team at all levels
  • creating and delivering presentations for industry conferences
  • Ability to document technical and functional requirements by partnering with business stakeholders and project team members.
  • Ability to separate the technology ask from the business need.
  • Consulting and client/project team relationship-building skills.
  • Strong functional background and demonstrated relevant industry expertise
  • Highly motivated self-starter.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to adhere to a firm’s methodology.
  • Willingness to master new processes and standards rapidly and evolve current approaches to accommodate requirements without delay or loss of quality.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to translate complex technical requirements into common language.
  • Experience with implementing key enterprise applications, including ERP, EAM and CRM
  • Working knowledge of financial accounting processes (Planning, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, Close, Budget, Tax, Physical Asset Management, Regulatory) for ERP implementations
  • Interest in software and technology solutions. Examples include:
  • Management information systems background.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreGreat Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, the Principal Product Designer will have primary product design responsibility for areas and projects for the enhancement and improvement of Great Minds software products.


Responsibilities

  • Utilize expert proficiency in software product design responsibilities relative to:

    • User research

    • User experience design

    • Visual design, and

    • Production-worthy HTML+CSS development, as needed

  • Weigh pros and cons and propose which design and research options to employ.

  • Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, product marketers, and others to identify key problems and solutions for the sake of Great Minds software users, both internal and external.

  • Co-lead and facilitate the product design thinking process with product management so the business prioritizes the right human problems to solve and co-lead the process of developing the user-facing solutions for users, incorporating the company and product brands appropriately and sufficiently.

  • Design delightful user flows and interactions that simplify the complex.

  • Serve as a thought leader and advocate for user experience.

  • Validate designs through user testing before launch to identify issues early on.

  • Review shipped features and identifies user experience improvements that can be made from data on usage (qualitative and quantitative).

  • Support the engineering team throughout the development process as they bring product designs to life.

  • Assist others with clearing their design and technical hurdles.

  • Take ownership by steering teams and their members in the right direction.

  • Collaborate to build, evolve, and refine the company’s design system, ensuring visual cohesion and engineering efficiency across all user touchpoints.

  • Take an active role in process improvements with the Product Design Director and other leaders.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience and mastery in the following:

    • User research, including user interviewing and user testing

    • User experience design, including Design Thinking methodologies

    • Visual design for the web, including modern tools like Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite

    • HTML and CSS development, with a dash of JavaScript to demonstrate dynamic designs to engineers

  • Mastery of industry-standard design software (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, web code editors, browser developer tools, etc.)

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, related field, or an additional 4+ years of industry experience in software product design for external, commercial users (B2C, B2B, EdTech, etc.)

Status

  • Full-time

About the Role

We are hiring a Client Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day social operations of a major US entertainment client.

Reporting to the Account Manager on the account, you will coordinate the operating rhythm behind the work: content approvals, stakeholder follow-up, meeting preparation, campaign project management, file organisation, episode deliveries, social-account access, and cross-workstream status visibility.

This is not passive administration. The role is about making complex work visible, organised, and dependable. You will know what is moving, what is waiting for approval, who owns the next step, where the latest file lives, and when a blocker needs to be escalated.

You will work across a high volume of moving parts and stakeholders, helping Storm and the client stay aligned as content, campaigns, meetings, approvals, assets, and access requirements move forward.

A significant part of the role is follow-through. You will be expected to chase inputs, maintain accurate trackers, capture decisions clearly, surface risks early, and make sure agreed actions actually happen.

If you enjoy bringing order to fast-moving work involving lots of people, deadlines, systems, and dependencies, this role will suit you well.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, an international team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working.

We use modern technology, including carefully selected AI-assisted tools, to create clearer workflows, make better decisions, catch problems earlier, and deliver consistently high-quality work.

What You Will Do

  • Coordinate high-volume social-content approvals, feedback, revisions, deadlines, and final sign-off across Storm and client stakeholders
  • Prepare for recurring meetings, capture decisions and actions, and make sure follow-ups are completed
  • Project-manage smaller social campaigns, maintaining clear timelines, owners, dependencies, approvals, assets, and risks
  • Keep client files, episode deliveries, social-account access, permissions, and related operational processes organised and up to date
  • Maintain shared trackers, calendars, and documentation so priorities, deadlines, blockers, and responsibilities remain visible
  • Chase inputs, surface risks early, escalate blockers appropriately, and keep work moving across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Keep operational processes, templates, contacts, and handover information current so work is reliable and repeatable

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience supporting client operations, social-content workflows, project delivery, account teams, or another fast-moving environment involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and approval routes
  • Strong organisation across multiple workstreams, deadlines, approval paths, versions, and dependencies
  • High ownership and a proactive approach to keeping work moving
  • Clear written communication and the ability to turn scattered feedback or ambiguous requests into concise actions, owners, and decisions
  • Experience preparing for recurring meetings, producing useful recaps, and following actions through to completion
  • Confidence coordinating high-volume approval workflows involving internal teams, senior stakeholders, legal review, or multiple revision rounds
  • Practical experience with file-management and project-management systems such as Box, Monday.com, Airtable, spreadsheets, or comparable tools
  • Good judgement about when to follow up, when to challenge, when to escalate, and when a decision sits outside your authority
  • A calm and dependable approach when work is late, unclear, blocked, or changing quickly
  • Confidence using modern productivity tools, including AI-assisted tools where appropriate, to prepare, organise, check, and follow through on work
  • Good judgement around checking AI-assisted outputs and handling confidential information carefully

What Success Looks Like

  • Approvals move through the correct stakeholders with accurate statuses, complete feedback, and no lost decisions
  • Meetings are properly prepared, decisions are clearly documented, actions have owners, and follow-up happens without repeated prompting
  • Campaign teams can quickly see the latest milestones, assets, versions, risks, approvals, and delivery status
  • Client and agency teams trust the operational picture because updates are clear, details are accurate, and blockers are raised early
  • Episode deliveries, files, account access, and recurring operational tasks are organised and dependable
  • Important context carries cleanly between Storm and client meetings rather than being lost between teams
  • Scope changes are made visible and discussed rather than quietly absorbed into the role
  • You do not wait for someone else to notice that something is slipping; you identify it, make it visible, and help drive it towards resolution

This Role Will Suit You If

  • You enjoy the operational side of social and campaign work: coordination, approvals, meetings, systems, timing, and follow-through
  • You like bringing order to work that spans many people, tools, and deadlines
  • You are naturally good at keeping track of details without losing sight of the bigger picture
  • You communicate warmly and clearly while still being willing to chase, challenge, and escalate
  • You like being the person who knows where things stand and what needs to happen next
  • You are comfortable working independently within clear boundaries and asking precise questions when authority or scope is unclear
  • You take satisfaction from making complicated workflows more reliable and easier for other people to work within

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tech Stack
We use modern collaboration, file-management, project-management, social-platform, password-management, and AI-enabled workflow tools to support our teams and clients.

Agility and Openness for Ideas
We actively encourage people to improve how work is organised and delivered. Operating with the agility of a growing company alongside the support of an established organisation means we value practical ideas, quick problem-solving, and strong follow-through.

Team-based
This is a dedicated, embedded role working closely with both Storm Ideas and client stakeholders. You will work with the Account Manager, strategy leads, production teams, and other client and agency stakeholders, with clear escalation routes for decisions and approvals.

Flexibility
Storm is a remote-first company. This particular role requires consistent working hours aligned to Pacific Time, currently expected to be approximately 9:00am–5:30pm PT, Monday to Friday.

Recruitment Process

Online video interview with short recorded answers to role-relevant questions.

First interview with Account Management leadership or the recruitment team

Practical exercise based on realistic operational inputs, asking you to produce a prioritised action plan and client update and explain how you used and checked the tools that supported your work, including AI where relevant
Second interview and exercise review with a senior leader

And that's it!

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

Job Description

Our mission is to efficiently create accurate and detailed pricing analyses to inform our current and potential homeowners of the earning potential for their rental home. We aim to reduce vacancy time for our homeowners by accurately pricing their home before it is listed.
This job is all about attention to detail, efficiency, and critical thinking; we’re looking for someone who can ensure all pricing analyses accurately reflect the current market value of the home through thorough analysis of the market in general and the relevant comparable homes. You will work with the sales team to answer any questions a homeowner might have about the analysis you have created and will be responsible for determining renewal pricing for currently managed homes, taking any rent control laws into consideration.

Role Responsibilities

  • Verify the accuracy of the property information by cross referencing our internal information with information found online from previous listings.
  • Flag any discrepancies for clarification.Choose accurate comparable properties for each home taking into consideration location, size, bed count, bath count, updates, and finishes.

  • Synthesize the similarities and differences between our home and the comparable properties into an easily understandable report for the homeowner to review.
  • Respond quickly to homeowner requests to increase the price and determine whether the increase is warranted or not, backing up your decision with market data.
  • Follow a designated process to determine whether a home is impacted by rent control regulations before setting renewal terms for actively managed homes.

About You

  • You are detail oriented: you can spot discrepancies, resolve issues proactively, and transfer information from one page to another without errors to avoid mispricing any of our homes. Mispricing a home can increase the vacancy cost the homeowner incurs and reduce the homeowners trust in our company.

jobs.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

1) providing the best services for homebuyers

2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance

3) to protect the whole home

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II
Location: India
Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II.

As a Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II , your charter is to build out theAgentic Platform at Porch Group — the shared foundation every team builds AI on. You will own how we build retrieval pipelines, deploy and manage remote agents, create MCP servers, route and govern model access, and evaluate all of it. When a new use case arrives, this team builds the scaffolding and often a proof of concept, then hands off to the feature team that owns the production system.
AI adoption here has moved fast: agentic coding tools are in active rollout across multiple business units, autonomous agents already open merge requests against production repositories, and a centralized LLM gateway is live. The platform runs primarily on Python with some TypeScript/Node, on Kubernetes and Google Cloud, alongside vector stores for retrieval, LLM evaluation and observability tooling, a workflow orchestration platform for production AI pipelines, and a growing fleet of internal MCP servers. Porch's product services are predominantly JVM-based (Java, Kotlin, Scala), and the agents you build will operate on that code.

What You Will Do As A Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II

  • Build out the Agentic Platform as a product for internal teams — find what teams keep rebuilding and turn it into a paved path with sane defaults.
    • Design, build, and operate internal MCP servers, and own the standards for them: auth (OAuth 2.1), tool and schema design, versioning, and testing — plus the scaffolding, templates, and registry that make creating one a solved problem.
    • Build the platform layer for remote agents: how an agent gets deployed, scheduled, credentialed, observed, rate-limited, and safely retired, across conversational, scheduled, and event-triggered shapes.
    • Build the guardrails that make autonomous agents trustworthy — scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop approval gates, sandboxed execution, audit logging, spend controls, and hard blast-radius limits.
    • Serve as technical lead for retrieval-augmented generation — shared patterns for ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval; vector stores; incremental sync; and retrieval quality owned as a measured discipline rather than a guess.
    • Own evaluation and observability for AI systems — eval harnesses, golden datasets built from the questions people actually ask and calibrated against domain experts, prompt versioning, and instrumentation through Opik, Datadog, and OpenTelemetry.
    • Advance the agentic developer experience — the internal plugin and skills library encoding Porch conventions, our code review agents, the autonomous bug and security remediation agents, and tooling that makes fleet-wide migration across dozens of JVM repositories tractable.
    • Extend and operate the LLM gateway (Portkey) — provider and model coverage, routing, secure access for business units outside the core Agentic Platform, and governance including access controls, PII monitoring, and cost attribution.
    • Build reference implementations and proofs of concept that establish a pattern, then hand off cleanly to the team that will own it in production.
    • Set standards and playbooks, mentor engineers across business units adopting AI tooling, give leadership straight answers on build versus buy, and participate in an on-call rotation for Agentic Platform services.

What You Will Bring As A Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred)
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building LLM-powered systems that reached production and at least 2 years in a senior or technical lead role.
    • Languages: production-grade Python is the primary language you will write. JVM fluency required — you can read and confidently modify a large Java or Kotlin codebase and its build tooling (SBT, Maven, Gradle), since the agents you build operate on that code; Scala is a plus, not a requirement. TypeScript/Node.js strongly preferred.
    • Hands-on MCP experience — building servers or clients, tool and schema design, auth — and agent orchestration with LangGraph or equivalent, including context and state management.
    • RAG in production — vector stores such as PostgreSQL/pgvector, embedding models, chunking and retrieval strategies, incremental sync, and how to tell whether retrieval is actually working.
    • Experience evaluating non-deterministic systems — eval harnesses, regression suites, quality gates, prompt versioning — and rigorous reasoning about latency and cost.
    • A working practitioner of agentic coding tools. Real production work with Claude Code or comparable, and informed opinions about where agents fail.
    • Security judgment for agentic systems — prompt injection defense, sandboxed execution, scoped credentials, audit logging, and containing an agent's blast radius.
    • Kubernetes and cloud experience, ideally GCP (GKE, IAM, GCS, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), plus GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, and observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
    • A platform builder's instincts and strong written communication — turning a business problem into a reusable capability, proving it with a focused proof of concept, and writing standards and clean, tested code others can build on.
    • Comfort participating in an on-call rotation, ability to overlap 2-3 hours with Pacific Standard Time (PST) core US business hours, and a collaborative approach in a trustful and respectful environment.
    • Proven experience working with US based business teams.
    • Excellent written and communication skills in English language.
  • Must currently reside in or are located within 150 km of Greater Delhi NCR, Greater Bangalore, or Greater Pune.
  • Working Hours: 8 Hours (Excluding breaks) — 4 Core US Hours Overlap (7:30pm–11:30pm IST), 4 flexible hours (IST)
  • Workspace: A quiet space to work, an internet connection of at least 30 Mbps download | 10 Mbps upload

Nice to Have

  • Building developer platforms or internal tooling with real adoption metrics behind it.
    • Replacing a third-party SaaS or AI vendor with in-house capability.
    • Scala depth, or large-scale JVM framework migrations.
    • No-code or low-code automation platforms (e.g., n8n) and enabling non-technical users.
    • Workflow orchestration platforms — Flyte/Union Cloud, Airflow, Temporal, or similar.
    • Open-source contributions to AI tooling, MCP servers, or agent frameworks.
    • AI governance in a regulated domain — insurance, financial services, or healthcare.

Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.
